skill.displayName: Remove Subtitles from Video Online Free – API-powered
skill.summary: Remove subtitles from video online free — remove subtitles or text overlays from a video

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the remove-subtitles-from-video-online-free-openapi-skill:

- Easily remove subtitles or text overlays from videos online, for free.
- Integrates with WeShop OpenAPI; requires API key (WESHOP_API_KEY) for authentication.
- Supports uploading video URLs and optional watermark detection mode.
- Provides clear instructions for API key security and endpoint usage.
- Allows polling run status and retrieving processed videos via API.
